verdict.rationale: Workable documents a broad REST API covering jobs, candidates (create, list, rate), offers, members, departments, requisitions, stages, permission sets, events and webhooks. It also documents an MCP server claiming "full programmatic access" across the hiring lifecycle. However, no evidence shows API parity for many UI features: several documented endpoints are read-only, and there is no published OpenAPI spec to verify coverage. missing for 10: evidence of API equivalents for UI features such as the careers page builder, custom report builder, multi-job-board posting, translation and AI sourcing/recommendations; write access for stages, offers and permission sets; a published machine-readable spec or independent confirmation of UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
It covers the entire hiring lifecycle — from job management and candidate sourcing through offer approvals
Creates a rating for a candidate. Required scope: `w_candidates`. Accessible with all token types.
Invites a member. Required scope: w_members. Accessible with all token types.
Merges an existing department with a target one in your account. Required scope: `w_departments`.
